events.verdict: Edwards (PHI) and Bridges (NYK) briefly engage and disengage following the pick.
Achiuwa (NYK) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Maxey's (PHI) driving shot attempt.
Prior to the pass, Hart (NYK) makes illegal contact to George's (PHI) wrist.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on George (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. George is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and while the preceding contact is a foul, it was not clearly and conclusively proximate to the ball going out of bounds.
Achiuwa (NYK) briefly grasps Drummond's (PHI) jersey before cleanly blocking his shot attempt near the rim.
George (PHI) steps into Brunson's (NYK) path and initiates illegal leg to leg contact that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Achiuwa (NYK) jumps alongside Maxey (PHI) and the body contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Hart (NYK) moves forwards into Oubre Jr.'s (PHI) lower body, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Edwards (PHI) moves into Brunson's (NYK) path and initiates illegal body contact that affects his SQBR during the drive.
